title: 三组配对计数的条件方差预算
domain: Hypothetical paired-count measurement or molecular null model
hypothesis: If three pairs of independent Poisson counts have equal within-pair rate products, conditioning on nonnegative pair offsets and a fixed total yields the source factorial law. For arbitrary nonlinear coordinate readouts, a factor2 sum-of-marginal-variances budget applies, improving the generic Cauchy factor3; older FQW26 already gives this same bound, so new-mathematics gain may be zero.
mapping: Let independent A_i~Pois(lambda_i),B_i~Pois(mu_i),i=1..3,with all rates positive and lambda_i mu_i=kappa common. Condition B_i-A_i=alpha_i>=0 and sum A_i=m. Joint conditional mass for X_i=A_i is proportional to product [(lambda_i mu_i)^xi mu_i^alpha_i/(xi!(xi+alpha_i)!)]; common kappa^m and fixed mu_i^alpha_i cancel. This is a model-based mapping, not a theorem about arbitrary measured shot noise.
judge: Obtain an actual paired-count workload and separately test independence, rate-product equality, conditioning and offsets. If useful, freeze exact finite-support probability/covariance oracle and nonlinear readout objectives before execution. Compare both a generic factor3 budget and the already available FQW26 factor2 result; source-law verification alone is a component check, not application gain.
baseline: FQW26v2 Lemma5.3 with dual projection/synthesis; conditional-law exact covariance when affordable; monotone-function negative association may already give stronger bounds. Do not select factor3 as the sole strong baseline.
limits: No actual sensor or biological workload, parameter calibration, independent domain review or experiment. Unequal rate products leave nonconstant coordinate tilts and are outside this extracted contract. No implication from F149 deterministic mass-action permanence to an independent Poisson model.
prediction_kind: Conditional transfer of an old mathematical budget to a specified stochastic model; not a new inequality
resource_envelope: No numerical allocation. Do not execute exponential graph enumeration or long chains before workload and bounded protocol are fixed. Future numerical raw,summary,source payloads gzip and decompressed hashes verified before removing plaintext.
